changelog: - **A Monte Carlo run no longer lands on another document.** A run kept going after another document was opened (New, a Template, a file, a share link or a Workspace), and when it ended its result replaced whatever the open document showed, even a result that document had just finished on its own. Opening another document now cancels the run in flight, and anything that run answers later changes nothing. A run started on the open document is finished and cancelled there only: Cancel no longer stops working when an older run ends first. Editing the same document during a run still lets the run finish, and its result is marked stale as before.
